    def reset(self):
        self.f = codecs.open(self.filename,self.mode, self.encoding)


    def write(self, sentence):
        #TODO: write index
        for word, lemma, pos in sentence:
           if not word: word = "NONE"
           if not lemma: lemma = "NONE"
           if not pos: pos = "NONE"
           self.f.write( word + "\t" + lemma + "\t" + pos + "\n" )
